Ariel: Morning all — quick async pulse for today. Updated the feature-priority list in Figma; blocker: infra needs to confirm canary capacity. Please drop 1-line what you did / blockers / plan for today. Ping me for any spec clarifications.

Devon: Done: A/B reqperf microbench completed. Blocker: waiting on model config from Samir to run quant tests. Today: will open PR for retry/backoff and review Jo's mocks. @Samir can you share the model artifact tag?

Samir: Uploaded tag: `redwood/gptx:2026-03-16-q8`. Small caveat — slight perf regression on very long prompts, investigating. Today: run long-sequence sweep and post results by EOD.

Jo: Design update: API surface in Figma refreshed, added example payloads. Need someone to sanity-check `metadata` field usage. @Devon can you take a quick look? Variant screenshots in /design/assets.

Taylor: Manager note: prioritize checklist item #3 (canary routing policy). If infra can't unblock today, we should push the canary rollout to next Tue. @deploy-bot any ETA on infra review?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary capacity request queued with infra. Expected review in ~2 hours. Ticket INF-4821 :hourglass:

Devon: Ack. If infra is delayed I'll add a temporary routing policy limiting token-rate to 50rps so we can smoke test without blasting capacity.

Ariel: Quick prioritization call — hold advanced quantization until post-launch. Scope cut: first rollout uses `fp16` profile. Please add note to PRs and rollouts.

Samir: Confirmed — switching canary config back to `fp16-stable` for the rollout.

Jo: Quick UI question: do we expose per-route cost breakdown in Console v1? If yes I need the schema ASAP. cc @Ariel

Ariel: Yes — minimal cost view for v1 (token counts + estimated cost). Send a sample JSON shape and I'll sign off.

Jo: Sample payload: ```{ "route": "/generate", "tokens": 1200, "est_cost": 0.024 }```

Devon: CR ping: drafted PR #3284 for retry/backoff. @Taylor could you review? Small change, mostly tests.

Taylor: On it. Will review before lunch.

Samir: Blocker update: long-seq perf looks like KV cache thrash around step ~512. Instrumenting and will follow up with flamegraphs.

Ariel: :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll consolidate notes and update the roadmap doc. If anything slips or you need a decision, call it out here.
